title: Living for the Audience of One
headline: How to Live for an Audience of One
headline_sub: What Would Please My Father Today?
tagline: The person who no longer lives for applause often becomes the most trustworthy person in the room.
seo_title: Living for an Audience of One: Colossians 3:23-24 for Men | TheWrkShop
seo_description: Living for God doesn't make you care less about people. It frees you to love them honestly. A devotional on Colossians 3:23-24 for men.
verse_text: Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men….

scriptures.text: Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men….

blocks.text: Here’s the beautiful balance of the Kingdom.

items: Living for God doesn’t make you care less about people.
It teaches you to love people better.
When I no longer need your approval….
I’m finally free to serve you honestly.
I can tell the truth instead of merely telling you what you want to hear.
I can build instead of manipulate.
I can forgive instead of keeping score.
I can lead instead of following the crowd.

blocks.text: Ironically, the person who no longer lives for applause often becomes the most trustworthy person in the room.

items: Because his decisions aren’t purchased by acceptance.
He isn’t controlled by compliments.
He isn’t destroyed by criticism.
His compass points somewhere higher.
This doesn’t mean we’ll never struggle.
Even the apostle Paul battled misunderstanding.
Jesus Himself was praised one week and crucified the next.
The crowd is unstable.
The Kingdom is not.
The crowd changes with emotion.
The Father never changes.
That’s why mature disciples don’t wake up asking, “What will everyone think of me today?”
Instead they ask, “What would please my Father today?”
That one question changes everything.
It transforms work….
Marriage….
Parenting….
Leadership….
Friendship….

blocks.text: Every decision begins with the right audience.
Tomorrow morning, before checking your phone, ask one question:
Then let every other decision flow from that answer.

items: Father,
Teach me to live before Your face.
Help me love people deeply without becoming controlled by their opinions.
May Your approval become my peace, my confidence, and my direction.
Let me become the kind of man who follows the Kingdom even when the crowd walks away.
In Jesus name,
Amen.
